content: Linux time_namespaces(7): time namespaces virtualize only CLOCK_MONOTONIC and CLOCK_BOOTTIME; 'time namespaces do not virtualize the CLOCK_REALTIME clock' - containers/pods always share the host/node wall clock. docker/for-mac issue #17 (2016, 52 comments, 78 +1s): Moby VM clock freezes during host sleep, container time lags by sleep duration after wake. K8s pod clock == node kernel clock; NTP hygiene on cluster nodes is an ops prerequisite.
